import json, sys
from pathlib import Path
from tools.surface_screen_result_check import entry_revision_identity

root=Path('.')
tmp=Path(sys.argv[1])
new_targets=json.loads((root/'.ai/task/repair-w64-20261003/NEW-TARGETS.json').read_text())
workset=json.loads((root/'.ai/task/repair-w64-20261003/WORKSET.json').read_text())['items']
by_old={item['entry_revision_identity']:item for item in workset}
assert set(by_old)==set(new_targets), 'WORKSET and NEW-TARGETS inventories differ'

    return [json.loads(line) for line in path.read_text().splitlines()]

def semantic(record):
    value=dict(record); value.pop('line',None); return value

changed=[]
counts={}
for file,stem in [('engine.lua','engine'),('mod-tome.lua','mod-tome')]:
    baseline=load(tmp/f'baseline-{stem}.jsonl')
    current=load(tmp/f'current-{stem}.jsonl')
    assert len(baseline)==len(current), f'{file}: record count changed'
    counts[file]=len(current)
    for index,(before,after) in enumerate(zip(baseline,current)):
        b=semantic(before); a=semantic(after)
        if b==a: continue

        assert b_without==a_without, f'{file}: non-target record change at record {index}'
        candidates=[(rid,item) for rid,item in new_targets.items() if item['file']==file and item['section']==a.get('section') and item['source_tag']==a.get('source_tag') and item['old_target']==old and item['new_target']==new]
        assert len(candidates)==1, f'{file}: changed target does not match exactly one frozen item at record {index}'
        rid,item=candidates[0]
        changed.append((rid,index,a))
assert len(changed)==26, f'expected 26 changed records, got {len(changed)}'
assert len({rid for rid,_,_ in changed})==26, 'duplicate changed revision'
assert {rid for rid,_,_ in changed}==set(new_targets), 'changed revision inventory mismatch'
revisions=[]
for old_revision,index,row in sorted(changed):
    frozen=by_old[old_revision]
    new_revision=entry_revision_identity(
        logical_entry_identity=frozen['logical_entry_identity'],
        source=frozen['source'],
        target=new_targets[old_revision]['new_target'],
        fixed_source_identity=frozen['fixed_source_identity'],
        terminology_snapshot=frozen['terminology_snapshot_sha256'],
        rules_version=frozen['rules_version'],
        args_order=frozen['args_order'],
    )
    revisions.append({'old_revision':old_revision,'new_revision':new_revision,'file':new_targets[old_revision]['file'],'section':new_targets[old_revision]['section']})
    print(f'{old_revision}\t{new_revision}\t{new_targets[old_revision]["file"]}\t{new_targets[old_revision]["section"]}')
summary={'status':'PASS','baseline':'.ai/task/repair-w64-20261003/baseline','loaded_files':['engine.lua','mod-tome.lua'],'record_counts':counts,'changed_target_count':len(changed),'all_new_targets_exact':True,'all_other_record_fields_unchanged':True,'revisions':revisions}
(tmp/'comparison.json').write_text(json.dumps(summary,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+'\n')
print(f'COMPARISON_JSON={tmp / "comparison.json"}')
print(f'PASS records engine={counts["engine.lua"]} mod-tome={counts["mod-tome.lua"]} changed_targets={len(changed)}')
